result.answer: A delivered demonstration milestone can be accepted after the agreed checks pass and the customer provides written confirmation. The customer has five business days to review it; silence does not count as acceptance. Support begins on the date of written acceptance and covers reproducible defects within the agreed scope for thirty calendar days.

citations.quote: The customer has five business days to review a delivered demonstration milestone. Acceptance requires written confirmation after the agreed checks pass. Silence does not constitute acceptance.
The demonstration support period starts on the date of written acceptance. It covers correction of reproducible defects within the agreed scope for thirty calendar days.

result.title: Proposed Website and CRM Integration Plan

tasks.title: Confirm scope and project constraints
tasks.description: Agree on the five-page site structure, content and design requirements, contact-form fields, CRM provider and API access, budget, and six-week target. Record assumptions and identify any items that could affect schedule or cost.

tasks.title: Prepare requirements and implementation design
tasks.description: Define page content and user journeys, form validation and consent requirements, CRM data mapping, integration behavior, security considerations, and acceptance criteria. Confirm a delivery plan based on the agreed scope and access.

tasks.title: Build the website and contact form
tasks.description: Implement the five-page English presentation website and responsive contact form according to the approved design and requirements. Include appropriate validation and clear success and error messages.

tasks.title: Implement the CRM API integration
tasks.description: Connect the contact form to the selected CRM API using approved credentials and field mappings. Handle API errors safely and ensure sensitive credentials are not exposed in the website.

tasks.title: Test and resolve issues
tasks.description: Test all pages, responsive behavior, form validation, CRM data transfer, error handling, and agreed acceptance criteria. Address identified defects and obtain client approval for the delivery candidate.

tasks.title: Prepare delivery and launch handover
tasks.description: Provide the approved website files or agreed deployment package, configuration and operating notes, and a handover summary. Schedule any launch activity only after client approval and confirmation of hosting and access.
